notes.title: Timelie Patch 1.4 Is Out! Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Timelie players!

We're excited to release version 1.2.4 of Timelie, which includes some important bug fixes. We appreciate your support and feedback as we continue to improve the game.

Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*]Resolved graphic issues caused by corrupted shader and baked lighting.
[*]Fixed mouse input detection delay issues, resulting in smoother and more responsive gameplay. 
[/list]

Thank you for playing Timelie! We hope these fixes improve your experience and make your time adventures even more fun!

notes.title: Timelie Patch 1.3 Is Out Now! - Compatibility Update
notes.notes:
Good day to you all!

The wait is over! Since we got many suggestions and feedback, Timelie will now support macOS M1 chip devices, and Steam Deck! You can play Timelie everywhere you go!

We are excited to deliver a new experience to play Timelie the way you want. We're always happy to welcome new players and returners who want to challenge yourself once more. 

Patch Note:
[list]
[b][*] MacOS with M1 Chip supported
[*] Steam Deck supported
[*] Japanese Localization Enhancements[/b]
[/list]

Thank you for being one of our valued players, and stay tuned for our next updates!

notes.title: Timelie Update Patch 1.2 Out Now! - Controller Support
notes.notes:
Finally, the feature that was requested the most, Timelie will now have full controller support! It is time to dust off your trusty controller to use it to play Timelie! And control the time within your palms(and index fingers!)

We are excited to bring you guys a new experience to play Timelie. We also gladly welcome new players who jump into the fray or returners who would like to have a challenge with the game once more. 

Patch Note:
[list]
[*] Full Controller Support with a new feature specifically designed to improve QoL for the controller.
[*] Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch Controller Layout.
[/list]

We hope you are enjoying our game, and we will continue to support Timelie with updates in the future. Thank you for being one of our valued customers, and we will see you all in the next update!

Note:
[b]This patch is now available only for Windows.[/b] We couldn't update the Mac OS version due to some technical issue with the M1 chip. To be honest, we couldn't find a way to access the device (Our team is now working at home, and everyone is using Windows 🥺). We are trying to solve it and hope to fix it in the future. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience for Mac OS users.

notes.title: Hotfix for achievement issues
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We have a small hotfix for achievement issues.

[list]
[*] Fix '[b]The Beginning[/b]' achievement not being unlocked. [b]Please re-enter the game again after the update and it should unlock this achievement automatically.[/b] [i]This issue only affects the game with version 1.0.4.[/i]

[*] Ensure to unlock a relic related achievement when playing a level where its relic is already collected to help fix an issue where achievements not being unlocked after getting a relic (Rare case).
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the game.
Sorry for the inconvenience.  ːsteamfacepalmː

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We have an update that includes improvements of the game.

[h2]Feature/Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Add [b]Cutscene Skip[/b] which allows you to skip any cutscenes in the game (by holding [SPACEBAR]) [i]after the first playthrough of any stages[/i]


[*]Allow Options to display during cutscenes

[*]Change the color of the selected character's path to match their outlined color

[*]Prevent double-clicking on switches which may toggle doors twice
[/list]



If you have any feedback/bug report, feel free to tell us in the discussion forum.

Thank you for playing ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi folks and cat slaves!,

We just have a small update that includes minor bug fixes, and graphic improvements in various stages.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
- Fixed a bug where the cat can exit from the middle of a vent path in some stages. (This bug doesn't affect the solutions.)
- Fixed a bug where the options menu can't be closed in some situations.
- Fixed graphic glitches in some stages.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
- More precise enemy's vision graphic in some stages.

[h2]OBS Studio Issue[/h2]
We also found that OBS Studio (on Windows) with version 25 or above can't see Timelie in the Game Capture/Window Capture list.

This issue is from OBS Studio's source code itself, where it accidentally excludes all applications starting with a keyword "Time..." from the list.

We've already reported this to the OBS forum and it might be fixed in their next release.
Please use  [url=https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/releases/tag/24.0.3]OBS Studio 24.0.3[/url] or lower for streaming/recording at the moment.

We're also working on the skip cutscene functionality in the next patch.


If you found a bug/glitch of the game or have any suggestions, please let us know.


Hope you all enjoy the game!
Thank you for playing ːsteamhappyː
